Class GameEnded

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.shared.network.responses.ServerResponse
org.adsl.shared.network.responses.GameEnded
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GameEnded extends ServerResponse
Response broadcast to all players when a game ends.

results holds the per-player final scores (MatchResult — nickname, prestige points, food) used to render the end-game screen. records holds the all-time leaderboard fetched from the database after saving the match; it is empty when the server runs without a DBMS. Both lists are null if the game ended before it started (all lobby players left without the game being started).
